name: Portugal
hook: A small seafaring nation Jeopardy asks about through explorers, colonies and cork.

facts.label: Iberian Peninsula
facts.statement: Portugal shares the Iberian Peninsula with Spain and is the westernmost country in mainland Europe.

facts.label: Vasco da Gama
facts.statement: Vasco da Gama sailed from Portugal in 1497 and opened the sea route to India; The Lusiads celebrates the voyage.

facts.label: Brazil
facts.statement: Pedro Cabral claimed Brazil for Portugal in 1500, and in 1807 the Portuguese court fled there ahead of Napoleon.

facts.label: Lisbon
facts.statement: Lisbon, Portugal's capital, sits on the Tagus estuary and like Rome is built on seven hills.

facts.label: the Azores and Madeira
facts.statement: The Azores and Madeira are Portuguese island groups in the Atlantic; King Afonso VI was banished to the Azores.

facts.label: Angola and Mozambique
facts.statement: Angola and Mozambique were Portuguese colonies until both gained independence in 1975.

facts.label: Macao
facts.statement: Portugal returned Macao, its territory at the mouth of the Pearl River, to China in 1999 after more than four centuries.
